blocks.label: clues
blocks.extractionHint: Keep witnesses' exact words, conflicting details, reasoning and untested guesses. The Case Board already holds sources, contradictions, preservation and verification status; add the course of conversations and reasoning here without another copy of current values.

blocks.label: relics
blocks.extractionHint: Record ancient relics obtained or seen, with their appraisals, effects, risks and ownership.

blocks.label: tides
blocks.extractionHint: Keep observations and rumors about ebbs, fog beasts and safe windows. The Deep Ebb records its stage and character attributes record fog-rot; do not duplicate them here.

blocks.label: commitments
blocks.extractionHint: Keep the history of promises and trades with the four factions: who was promised what, what was received and on which terms. Faction Standing records current attitudes, permits, warrants and favors.
